g.text: 1. Pipe/fittings/flanges per class B2 (CFU-000-PI-SPC-001); BW fittings ASME B16.9, flanges B16.5/B16.47A RF.
2. Hydrotest 44.7 barg per ASME B31.3 345.4 (vents at high points, drains at low points).
3. PWHT: YES - all thk (P-No.5B, B31.3 Tbl 331.1.1) 705-770 C. NDE: 100 % RT of BW; 100 % MT/PT of fillets; HB <= 241; 100 % PMI.
4. Supports: RS rest/shoe, GD guide, ANC anchor, SPR variable spring - tags PS-<area><seq>-nn.
5. Welds: dot = shop weld, crossed circle FW = field weld; spools <= 12 m for transport.
6. Discharge check + block valves in riser above each pump (accessible from grade).
7. Rack run on tier 1 (hot B2) at rack south edge; expansion loops raised +1.0 m.
8. FV-1083 / FE / XV station at grade (EL 101.2) north of H-201 for operator access.
9. Riser at H-201 supported from heater structure with variable spring hangers.
